name: RHP: The Horse: The Videogame
summary: RHP: The Horse: The Videogame (AKA "RHP3" or "RHP: RealHorsePiss: The Horse: The Videogame: The Demo: 1+2: It Equals 3") is an upcoming game in the RHP (RealHorsePiss) series based on the website of the same name. Featuring RPG mechanics and four main playable horse-themed characters, Crail and friends attempt to uncover the conspiracy of FHP (That's FakeHorsePiss by the way) and take them down.
